title: C: Max of Three
description: Find the maximum of three integers using if-else statements and print it.

steps.title: Find Maximum
steps.description: Declare `int a=10, b=25, c=17`. Use nested if-else to find and print the largest value.
hints: Compare a and b first to find the larger.
Then compare that result with c.
Alternatively, use `(a > b ? a : b)` for simplicity.

verification.failureMessage: Find and print the largest of a, b, and c
